stories.title: Who is Falls County Jane Doe? Woman found in 2000 may have died in the 1980s
stories.summary: Investigators found clothing, bedding and a distinctive heart charm alongside the woman's remains.

stories.title: Texas DPS helicopter crew rescues seriously injured teen from canyon in Guadalupe Mountains National Park
stories.summary: The 13-year-old girl was drifting in and out of consciousness after a serious head injury about 3 miles from a trailhead, officials said.

stories.title: Two men found dead after Stonewall hostage situation, sheriff says
stories.summary: Gillespie County Sheriff Ayala described the deaths as a murder-suicide after negotiations failed to resolve a standoff that began with a 911 call.

stories.title: San Antonio man accused of punching ex 20 times, pointing gun at her head on northwest side of town
stories.summary: The woman escaped after an alleged assault while collecting her belongings from their former shared apartment, according to an arrest warrant.

stories.title: Video helps police identify teen accused in northeast-side apartment robbery
stories.summary: Two 17-year-olds face aggravated robbery charges after three people were reportedly held at gunpoint at the Costa Biscaya Apartments in October.

stories.title: Truck fire spreads to two west side homes, displacing three people
stories.summary: Firefighters quickly extinguished the early Thursday blaze, but electricity remained off because of aging wiring, according to a battalion chief.

stories.title: Largest enrollment drop in Texas’ recorded history means challenges for public schools, Morath says
stories.summary: Texas lost about 135,000 students from last school year, outpacing pandemic-era declines, education commissioner Mike Morath said.

stories.title: One in three Texas students leaves college without a degree, new study says
stories.summary: In the last five years, those who left college and didn’t return within a year accumulated a total of about $1 billion in student debt.

stories.title: 'It's upsetting': Alamo Heights ISD parents question mid-semester GPA change to dual credit courses
stories.summary: Alamo Heights ISD parents challenge the school board's reduction of GPA multipliers for dual credit courses, fearing impacts on students' academic paths and GPA.

stories.title: SAPD officer arrested on sexual assault charge for alleged 2019 incident, placed on administrative duty
stories.summary: In 2024, San Antonio police received a report of an allegation of sexual assault against Officer Marcus Bazan for an incident that happened in 2019.

stories.title: Advocate urges action after homeless woman's death highlights dangers of cold weather
stories.summary: Susana Mendez Segura, a dedicated advocate for the homeless, discovered a woman who had passed away outside the Esperanza Peace and Justice Center.

stories.title: Silver Alert issued for 87-year-old woman last seen in Windcrest
stories.summary: Jenell Santafield was last seen in the 9300 block of Northbend Drive around 2 p.m. Wednesday. She was wearing a floral pattern dress with tan shoes.
